crossRefs.note: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he…
“These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.
Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are…
Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him, and he can’t know…

translations.web: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
translations.bsb: The Light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
translations.kjv: And the light shineth in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not.
translations.asv: And the light shineth in the darkness; and the darkness apprehended it not.
